zh.title: 美國七家航空公司遭訴訟指控 涉共用數據聯合抬高票價
zh.summary: 訴訟指控美國7家航空公司涉嫌共用資料庫監控票價；迅速跟進比價並聯合抬高機票價格。
body: 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導，美國 7 家航空公司近日遭提出訴訟，指控這些航空公司透過共用價格數據的方式聯合壟斷，以達成提高機票價格的目的。
相關訴訟指出，涉案航空公司據稱利用一個共享資料庫來監控市場票價變動，並藉由該系統快速跟進與匹配價格較低廉的機票。
這起訴訟主要針對航空公司間是否藉由共享數據庫進行票價監控與跟進比價，相關指控正由法律訴訟程序處理中。

en.title: Lawsuits Accuse Seven US Airlines of Colluding to Raise Fares via Shared Pricing Data
en.summary: Seven US airlines face lawsuits alleging use of a shared database to collude and raise fares.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying, seven US airlines are facing lawsuits accusing the carriers of colluding to raise ticket fares by sharing pricing data.
The lawsuits allege that the airlines used a shared database to monitor ticket prices across the market and quickly match cheaper tickets offered by competitors.
By utilizing this shared database to monitor competitor pricing and match lower rates, the legal claims allege the carriers coordinated to elevate overall ticket prices.
